author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Anbernic RG DS Plus is a nice improvement over the original RG DS, with better screens, controls, and audio - all coming in under $100. Among the dual-screen emulation handhelds available, this one feels the closest to an original DS (but falls short in a couple ways, too).

Anbernic direct: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RGDSPlus
AliExpress: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c4T10aM5

Nintendo Switch touch pen: https://amzn.to/48vajG7
Miniloong Pocket 1: https://youtu.be/da3f2fVTNWM

Anbernic RG DS videos:
Review video: https://youtu.be/MFu4goCqEko
Linux update video: https://youtu.be/E33ZdLwtaAM

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
